title: Licence server unreachable
symptom: A design app says it cannot contact the licence server for every user
user_description: The planning software says 'cannot contact licence server' and won't open. Everyone in Operations has the same message since 9am.

options.text: Reinstall the app on every PC
options.why: Everyone fails at once, so the app on the PCs is not the cause.

options.text: Use a licence key found online
options.why: Illegal, unsafe, and could bring malware into the company.

options.text: Tell users to wait for it to fix itself
options.why: A whole team cannot work, and the cause needs finding.

options.text: Everyone failing points to the server side. Note the time and the exact error, then escalate
options.why: When every user gets the same error at once, the shared part is the problem: the licence server or its service.

hints: What do all the PCs share?
Who looks after the licence server?
real_world_tip: Check whether the licence server itself was restarted or updated around 9am. That is often the trigger.

escalation.team_why: The licence server is a shared server, so the server team checks it and its licence service.

details.text: The app name and the exact error message
details.why: Tells them which licence service to check.

details.text: That everyone in Operations is affected
details.why: Shows it is a server problem, not one PC.
Helps them match it to a restart, update or expiry.

details.text: Use a free licence key from a website
details.why: Unlicensed keys are illegal and unsafe. Never suggest them.
Not needed, and passwords are never shared.
